title: attendance.clock_in
description: Clock in the session user. `source` is the mode of the device that clocks in: `shared` (the counter POS) or `personal` (the worker's own phone or laptop). When the hub requires location, a `personal` device is only accepted with `within_radius = 1`.

source.description: Device mode as answered by GET /api/device/mode.

lat.description: Latitude of the device when clocking in. Null when location is not required.

lng.description: Longitude of the device when clocking in. Null when location is not required.

accuracy_m.description: Accuracy of the position reported by the device, in metres.

distance_m.description: Distance to the workplace measured by the client (Haversine), in metres.

within_radius.description: 1 when the client measured the device inside the workplace radius, 0 outside, null when not measured.
